labels.quote: Apple reported total net sales of $383.3 billion in fiscal 2023 (Source: Apple 10-K FY2023).
Total net sales declined 2.8% from $394.3 billion in fiscal 2022 to $383.3 billion in fiscal 2023.
Services net sales grew 11.2% from $78.1 billion in fiscal 2022 to $85.2 billion in fiscal 2023.
Gross margin was $169.1 billion in fiscal 2023.
Research and development expense was $26.3 billion in fiscal 2023.
Net income was $97.0 billion in fiscal 2023.
